correctness.rationale: For every m≥2, positive ordered weights and α∈[0,1], computed coalition worth explicitly. Singleton and complementary-leaf constraints force empty core below 1/2; at/above 1/2, efficiency plus independent leaf intervals imply all coalition inequalities, yielding the exact box and vertex count. The external game has a checked telescoping unanimity expansion, leading to exact Shapley coefficients. Summation by parts proves the normalized coefficient order, the first leaf controls the sharp threshold, and nested marginal contributions prove strict failure of supermodularity below α=1. The standalone exact-rational enumerator independently reconstructs all coalition worths and permutation/subset Shapley formulas and passes 157 cases, 1,596 vertices, and 101,360 coalition inequalities. Infinite quantification rests on the analytic argument, not these checks.

value.rationale: The model source explicitly identifies interpolation of internal and external trust as a motivated open direction. Directed in-stars are a canonical graph class with arbitrary heterogeneous incoming weights. The exact nonemptiness phase, continuous m-dimensional core box, sharp weighted Shapley-core phase transition and non-supermodular stability regime are structural results for every m and all positive weights, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice, simple restatement or isolated computational instance.
